translation: 团队运行了对抗性测试，以观察分类器如何处理恶意输入。

translation: 我们雇了一家设计公司来为开源项目重建落地页。

translation: 这期播客节目解释了炼金术如何为现代化学奠定早期基础。

translation: 迁移已接近完成，只剩两个遗留表等待转换。

translation: 在生成报告之前，先将导入的 CSV 列按字母顺序排序。

translation: 我们评估了用 Redis 替代 Memcached 作为会话存储的方案。

translation: 在推送分支接受评审之前，你可以修改最后一次提交的信息。

translation: 他用图书馆的类比来解释数据库连接池存在的原因。

translation: 对代码库的静态分析在支付模块中发现了三处内存泄漏。

translation: 分析仪表盘按浏览器和地区细分展示了页面加载时间。

translation: 文档中的链接会跳转到同一页面上的锚点，方便快速导航。

translation: 仪表盘从 API 获取数据时会播放加载动画。

translation: 新的暗色主题改善了应用的外观，且未改动任何布局逻辑。

example: The applicability of this pattern depends on whether your workload is read-heavy.
translation: 这一模式是否适用，取决于你的工作负载是否以读为主。

translation: 先选择合适的数据结构再优化；过早调优只会浪费工程时间。

translation: 这个拉取请求需要两位维护者批准后才能合并。

translation: 这位软件架构师提议将单体应用拆分为三个领域服务。

translation: CI 流水线会把每个构建产物上传到制品库以供审计。

translation: 从整体上看，系统通过了负载测试，但个别服务仍然滞后。

example: A single bad deploy can trigger as many as five hundred alerts in monitoring.
translation: 一次糟糕的部署可能在监控中触发多达五百条告警。

example: Logging is one aspect of observability that teams often underestimate during design.
translation: 日志是可观测性的一个方面，团队在设计阶段常常低估它。

translation: 汇编器会在链接器运行之前把助记符翻译成机器码。

example: Always assert that the input is not null before parsing the JSON payload.
translation: 在解析 JSON 数据之前，务必断言输入不为空。

example: The unit test failed because the assertion expected a status code of two hundred.
translation: 单元测试失败了，因为断言期望的状态码是二百。

example: Before the migration, the team ran a thorough assessment of the legacy database.
translation: 迁移前，团队对遗留数据库进行了全面评估。

example: Each ticket in the queue is assignable to any available engineer.
translation: 队列中的每张工单都可以分配给任何空闲的工程师。

example: Every bug assigned to me was fixed before Friday's release.
translation: 分配给我的每个缺陷都在周五发布前修复了。

example: The patent assignee holds all rights to the open-source project's trademark.
translation: 该专利受让人拥有这个开源项目商标的全部权利。

example: The compiler rejected the assignment because the variable was declared constant.
translation: 编译器拒绝了该赋值，因为变量被声明为常量。

translation: 这个编程助手在代码审查时建议了一个更简单的重构。

example: Always delete the cache entry associated with the stale session token.
translation: 务必删除与过期会话令牌关联的缓存条目。

translation: 永远不要信任用户输入；关于载荷的每一项假设都应校验。

translation: WAF 在 SQL 注入攻击到达数据库前将其拦截。

translation: 每个服务上线前我们都会做安全审计。

example: We augmented the training set with synthetic samples to improve accuracy.
translation: 我们用合成样本扩充训练集以提高准确率。

example: The new hot-reload workflow is awesome; my feedback loop shrank to milliseconds.
translation: 新的热重载工作流太棒了，我的反馈循环缩短到毫秒级。

example: I had to babysit the deployment job because it kept failing overnight.
translation: 我不得不盯着这个部署任务，因为它整晚都在失败。

example: The client and server exchange messages back and forth over the WebSocket.
translation: 客户端和服务器通过 WebSocket 来回交换消息。

example: The crash reporter printed a full backtrace so we could find the bug.
translation: 崩溃报告器打印了完整的回溯信息，方便我们定位缺陷。

example: Add a build status badge to the README so contributors see CI results.
translation: 在 README 里加一个构建状态徽章，让贡献者看到 CI 结果。

example: We shipped the appliance as a barebone so customers could add their own RAM.
translation: 我们把设备做成准系统出货，方便客户自行加内存。

example: Basically, the cache is just a hash map with an expiry policy.
translation: 基本上，缓存就是一个带过期策略的哈希表。

example: The CI bot opens pull requests on behalf of every contributor.
translation: CI 机器人代表每位贡献者创建拉取请求。

example: Document any non-obvious behavior of the API in the README.
translation: 把 API 任何不明显的行为都写进 README。

translation: 用 git blame 找出是谁引入了竞态条件。

translation: 每天早上的站会前他都会冲一壶新鲜的咖啡。

translation: 在深入代码之前，我先简单讲一下整体架构。

translation: 事件溯源是个简单的概念，但实践中很容易被误解。

translation: 请在问题标题里简明地描述问题，这样分诊会更快。

translation: 接口看起来很清晰，但周五前我们还需要一个具体实现。

example: The team will conduct a load test before the launch to find bottlenecks.
translation: 团队将在发布前进行负载测试，以找出瓶颈。

example: The error message was so confusing that nobody could tell which service failed.
translation: 这条错误信息让人看不懂，没人能分辨是哪个服务出了问题。

example: A consentful design means users actively agree before any telemetry data leaves the device.
translation: “同意式”设计意味着任何遥测数据离开设备前都需用户主动同意。

example: It was considerate of him to document the migration steps for the on-call engineer.
translation: 他很体贴，为值班工程师记录了迁移步骤。

example: Security is the first design consideration when we architect a new microservice.
translation: 安全是设计新微服务架构时首要的考虑因素。

example: A deterministic build keeps the output consistent no matter which machine compiles it.
translation: 确定性构建让输出保持一致，无论哪台机器编译它。

translation: 该服务对任何未列入白名单的路径都始终返回 404。

translation: 常量能让编译器在编译期间捕获意外重复赋值的缺陷。
extendedMeanings: 持续不断的，经常发生的

example: During code review, focus on giving constructive feedback instead of just pointing out what is wrong.
translation: 代码评审时，应专注于给出建设性反馈，而不是只挑错。

partOfSpeech: noun (名词); verb (动词); adjective (形容词)

translation: 请直接联系值班工程师，而不是在公共频道发消息。

partOfSpeech: adjective (形容词); noun (名词); verb (动词)

translation: HTTP 的 Content-Type 头部告诉浏览器如何解析响应内容。

example: Our team practices continuous integration, merging code into the main branch several times a day.
translation: 我们团队实践持续集成，每天多次把代码合并进主分支。

example: I want to contribute to this open-source project by fixing the documentation typos.
translation: 我想通过修正文档笔误来为这个开源项目做贡献。

translation: 每位贡献者都必须先签署 CLA，其拉取请求才能被合并。

translation: 这个 API 封装很好用，因为它隐藏了 HTTP 请求的繁琐细节。

translation: 几次迭代后，梯度下降算法开始朝最优解收敛。

translation: 隐式类型转换会悄悄把整数变成浮点数，进而破坏比较逻辑。

partOfSpeech: verb (动词); noun (名词); adjective (形容词)

translation: 我们借助共享日历和异步站会，协调跨三个时区的发布。

partOfSpeech: noun (名词); verb (动词); adjective (形容词)

translation: 初创公司的吉祥物在科技大会展位上穿着机器人服装。

translation: 办公室吉祥物是一头塑料奶牛，摆在 CI 服务器顶上。

collocations.zh: 牛仔式编程，随心所欲写代码

example: Writing clean tests is part of the craft of software engineering, not just a chore.
translation: 编写整洁的测试是软件工程技艺的一部分，而非苦差事。

partOfSpeech: verb (动词); noun (名词); adjective (形容词); adverb (副词)

translation: 新部署让 API 网关在流量激增时反复崩溃。

example: Hackathons give engineers a whole week to explore creativity without shipping pressure.
translation: 黑客松给工程师一整周时间，在没有交付压力下发挥创造力。

example: Always give credit to the contributors in your README before open-sourcing the library.
translation: 开源这个库之前，记得在 README 里感谢各位贡献者。

example: Define clear acceptance criteria before the sprint starts so everyone knows when a story is done.
translation: 冲刺开始前要明确验收标准，让每个人都知道何时算完成。

coreMeaning: 极其重要的，关键的；危急的，严重的

translation: 对数据库查询做缓存，是保证首页响应低于 200 毫秒的关键。

example: The team maintains a curated list of learning resources for new backend engineers.
translation: 团队维护着一份为后端新人精心挑选的学习资源清单。

example: Being curious about the stack trace helped the junior developer fix the bug alone.
translation: 对堆栈跟踪的好奇心，帮助这位初级开发者独自修好了缺陷。

example: The senior engineer muttered a curse when the flaky test failed again.
translation: 当不稳定的测试再次失败时，资深工程师低声骂了一句。

example: Running the migration without a backup could cause irreversible damage to the production database.
translation: 不做备份就运行迁移，可能对生产数据库造成不可逆损坏。

example: It finally dawned on the intern that the bug was just a missing semicolon.
translation: 实习生终于意识到，这个缺陷只是一个缺失的分号。

example: Admins can deactivate a compromised account instantly from the security dashboard.
translation: 管理员可以在安全仪表盘上立即停用被盗用的账户。

example: He prefers dead-tree books when studying algorithms away from a screen.
translation: 不看屏幕学算法时，他更喜欢纸质书。

example: The team had a long debate about whether to adopt GraphQL for the new API.
translation: 团队为新 API 是否采用 GraphQL 争论了很久。

example: The payment API returns a debit entry whenever money leaves the customer's account.
translation: 资金每次从客户账户转出时，支付 API 就返回一条借记记录。

example: Move the function declaration above its first call to avoid the hoisting confusion.
translation: 把函数声明移到首次调用之前，避免提升带来的困惑。

example: We moved the workload to a dedicated server to stop noisy neighbors from stealing CPU.
translation: 我们把负载迁到专用服务器，免得吵闹邻居抢占 CPU。

example: The proof uses simple deduction: if the tests pass, the logic must be sound.
translation: 这个证明用了简单的演绎：测试全过，逻辑必然可靠。

example: JavaScript promises let you attach callbacks to deferred operations without blocking the main thread.
translation: Promise 让你为延迟操作挂上回调，而不阻塞主线程。

example: A slow DNS lookup can delay the first byte of every page load.
translation: 缓慢的 DNS 查询会拖慢每次页面加载的首字节。

example: Continuous delivery means every merge can be released to production with a single click.
translation: 持续交付意味着每次合并都能一键发布到生产环境。

example: The reviewer's demeaning tone made the junior engineer afraid to ask questions.
translation: 评审者贬损的语气，让初级工程师不敢再提问。

example: In UML diagrams, a solid arrow denotes a dependency between two classes.
translation: 在 UML 图中，实线箭头表示两个类之间的依赖关系。

example: The new API is a bold departure from the conventions used in version one.
translation: 新 API 大胆背离了第一版所遵循的惯例。

example: The utility is dependency-free, so you can drop it into any project safely.
translation: 这个工具零依赖，可以安全地加进任何项目。

example: The library still works, but the constructor is deprecated and will be removed next year.
translation: 这个库还能用，但该构造函数已被弃用，明年移除。

example: Engineers often derive a domain model from the requirements document before writing any code.
translation: 工程师通常在写代码前，先从需求文档推导出领域模型。

example: The process ran out of file descriptors after opening thousands of sockets without closing them.
translation: 进程开了数千个套接字却不关闭，文件描述符耗尽。

example: Kubernetes constantly reconciles the actual state with the desired state described in the manifest.
translation: Kubernetes 不断把实际状态调谐成清单里的期望状态。

example: Write a detailed bug report with steps to reproduce so the fix lands faster.
translation: 写一份带复现步骤的详细缺陷报告，修复会更快。

example: The linter flagged every detected vulnerability in the dependencies before the release.
translation: 发布前，检查工具标记了依赖中检测到的每个漏洞。

coreMeaning: 决定，起决定作用；查明，确定
example: Memory bandwidth is often the determining factor when choosing between two CPU architectures.
translation: 选型两种 CPU 架构时，内存带宽往往是决定性因素。

example: Every developer on the team reviews at least one pull request before lunch.
translation: 团队里每位开发者午饭前都要评审至少一个拉取请求。

example: A good diagnosis starts with reproducing the bug locally before touching any code.
translation: 像样的诊断先从本地复现缺陷开始，而不是先改代码。

coreMeaning: 诊断的；诊断程序，诊断工具
example: Run the built-in diagnostic tool before blaming the network for the connection timeouts.
translation: 把超时归咎于网络之前，先跑一遍内置诊断工具。

example: The ops engineer had to dial into the bridge line during the incident.
translation: 事故期间，运维工程师不得不拨号接入电话会议。

example: Multiple inheritance creates the diamond problem when two base classes share a common ancestor.
translation: 两个基类共享同一祖先时，多继承就会产生菱形问题。

example: Speech dictation tools are getting good enough to write boilerplate comments hands-free.
translation: 语音听写工具已经好到能免手写生成样板注释。

example: The checksum algorithm sums every digit of the card number and rejects invalid ones.
translation: 校验和算法累加卡号每位数字，并拒绝无效号码。

example: Each array dimension must be known at compile time for static allocation.
translation: 每个数组维度必须在编译时已知，以便进行静态分配。

example: The editor dimmed the inactive tabs so the focused file stands out.
translation: 编辑器将不活动的标签页变暗，使当前文件更突出。

example: The smart dashboard supports dimming its backlight after long periods of inactivity.
translation: 该智能仪表盘支持在长时间无操作后调暗背光。

example: The compiler directive tells the preprocessor to include the debug header.
translation: 该编译器指令告诉预处理器要包含调试用头文件。

example: The accessibility audit checks that every feature supports employees with a disability.
translation: 无障碍审计检查每个功能是否支持有残疾的员工使用。

coreMeaning: 分歧，意见不一；不符，不一致

translation: 由于对错误处理策略存在分歧，代码评审陷入了停滞。

example: An unhandled exception can make the file handle disappear without warning.
translation: 未处理的异常可能让文件句柄毫无预警地消失。

example: The parser will discard trailing whitespace before validating each token.
translation: 解析器会在验证每个词元之前丢弃末尾空白字符。

example: A little discord about the API design is healthy for the team.
translation: 团队在 API 设计上有点分歧反而是健康的现象。

example: Set the retry limit at your discretion; the defaults are safe.
translation: 重试次数上限由你自行决定，默认值是安全的。

example: The hiring algorithm was audited to make sure it was not discriminatory.
translation: 该招聘算法经过审计，以确保它不带有歧视性。

example: We had a long discussion about adopting gRPC for internal services.
translation: 我们就内部服务是否采用 gRPC 进行了长时间讨论。

example: The modal lets users dismiss the alert by pressing the escape key.
translation: 该模态框允许用户按 Escape 键关闭警报。

example: The event loop will dispatch each message to the correct handler.
translation: 事件循环会把每条消息分派给正确的处理程序。

example: Nobody disputed the need for integration tests during the standup meeting.
translation: 在站会上没有人质疑引入集成测试的必要性。

example: Reviewers should critique the code without being disrespectful toward its author.
translation: 评审者应批评代码，但不应不尊重其作者。

partOfSpeech: noun (名词); verb (动词); adjective (形容词)
example: Levenshtein distance measures how many single edits separate two given strings.
translation: 莱文斯坦距离衡量两个给定字符串之间相差多少次单步编辑。

example: The two error codes are barely distinguishable in the current log output.
translation: 这两个错误码在当前日志输出中几乎无法区分。

example: Check the response time distribution before tuning the connection pool size.
translation: 在调整连接池大小之前，先检查响应时间的分布情况。

example: Our diverse microservice stack includes Rust, Go, and Python services.
translation: 我们多样的微服务技术栈包含 Rust、Go 和 Python 服务。

coreMeaning: 多样性，多元化；差异，不同
example: Genetic diversity helps the optimizer escape local minima during search.
translation: 遗传多样性帮助优化器在搜索过程中跳出局部极小值。

example: Integer division in Python truncates the result toward negative infinity.
translation: Python 中的整数除法会把结果向负无穷方向截断。

example: The dot operator lets you access fields on the struct instance.
translation: 点运算符可用于访问该结构体实例上的字段。

partOfSpeech: noun (名词); verb (动词); adjective (形容词)

translation: 我提交了一份草稿拉取请求，以便及早收集对 API 的反馈。

example: The comment 'here be dragons' warns about the fragile legacy code below.
translation: 那条“此处有龙”的注释是在警告下面的遗留代码很脆弱。

example: The consumer drains the queue before the service shuts down gracefully.
translation: 该消费者会在服务优雅关闭之前排空队列。

partOfSpeech: noun (名词); adjective (形容词); verb (动词)

translation: 在部署到生产环境之前，把虚拟凭据换成真实的密钥。

example: A healthy package ecology helps developers discover well-maintained libraries more quickly.
translation: 健康的包生态能帮助开发者更快地发现维护良好的库。

example: The new cache layer makes lookups effectively instantaneous under normal load.
translation: 新的缓存层让查找在正常负载下几乎瞬时完成。

example: The new garbage collector is far more efficient under heavy load.
translation: 新的垃圾回收器在高负载下效率高得多。

example: Estimating the migration effort accurately remains the hardest part of planning.
translation: 准确估算迁移工作量仍然是计划中最难的部分。

partOfSpeech: conjunction (连词); pronoun (代词); adverb (副词); determiner (限定词); adjective (形容词)

translation: 你可以任选蓝色或绿色构建部署到预发环境。

translation: 系统会在进程退出前安全弹出 USB 卷。

translation: 在超时处理程序最终运行前，可能已过去了好几秒钟。

translation: 任务失败，因为已用时间超过了配置的上限。

example: She proposed an elegant recursive solution that replaced fifty lines of loops.
translation: 她提出了一个优雅的递归解法，取代了五十行循环代码。

translation: 在发布更新前，先在模拟器上测试 Android 构建版本。

translation: 清晰的文档能鼓励贡献者放心提交补丁，不用担心改坏东西。

example: Good tech leads encourage their teams to question assumptions during design reviews.
translation: 优秀的技术负责人在设计评审中会鼓励团队质疑既有假设。

example: The tutorial is engaging enough to keep new hires reading past lunch.
translation: 这份教程非常吸引人，新员工看过了午饭时间都停不下来。

example: The enhanced logging finally revealed why the cache kept missing.
translation: 增强后的日志终于揭示了缓存持续未命中的原因。

example: The tool performs a secure erasure of temporary files on every exit.
translation: 该工具会在每次退出时安全擦除临时文件。

example: Remember to escape user input before embedding it in the SQL query.
translation: 在把用户输入拼进 SQL 查询之前，记得先对其进行转义。

example: Unit tests are essential for safely refactoring this legacy module.
translation: 单元测试对于安全重构这个遗留模块必不可少。

translation: TCP 需要先建立连接，之后才会有应用数据流动。

example: The survey form asks for ethnicity only when legally required.
translation: 该调查表仅在法律要求时才会询问族裔。

translation: 解释器会在赋值结果之前先求每个表达式的值。

translation: 惰性求值会把昂贵的计算推迟到真正需要其结果时。

example: Retry the request even if the first attempt returns a server error.
translation: 即使第一次尝试返回了服务器错误，也请重试该请求。

translation: 在最终一致的存储中，分区恢复后各副本会趋于一致。

example: Our deployment strategy evolved from manual scripts to a full pipeline.
translation: 我们的部署策略从手动脚本逐步演变成了完整的流水线。

example: Floating point arithmetic rarely gives the exact result you expect.
translation: 浮点运算很少会给出你期望的精确结果。

example: The function returns exactly the value you requested, no more, no less.
translation: 函数恰好返回你请求的值，不多不少。

example: The API rejects requests that exceed the rate limit of one thousand calls per hour.
translation: API 会拒绝超过每小时一千次调用速率限制的请求。

partOfSpeech: preposition (介词); conjunction (连词); verb (动词)

translation: 除旧版计费模块外，所有注册到网关的微服务都报告健康。

translation: JSON 字符串中一个多余的感叹号在部署期间导致解析器出错。

translation: 添加一条排除规则，让备份任务完全跳过 node_modules 目录。

translation: 失控的递归在看门狗杀死进程之前就耗尽了栈空间。

translation: 详尽的测试运行至少覆盖 switch 语句的每个分支。

translation: 我们预计迁移脚本会在今晚维护窗口关闭前完成。

translation: 单元测试编码了我们对解析器应立即拒绝畸形输入的预期。

translation: 构建失败于一个意外错误，而非预期的编译器警告。

translation: 十年的后端经验让她几分钟内调试好了分布式事务。

example: The experimental feature is hidden behind a flag and not enabled in production.
translation: 该实验性功能隐藏在标志开关后面，未在生产环境启用。

partOfSpeech: noun (名词); adjective (形容词); verb (动词)

translation: 一位内存泄漏专家参加站会，审查我们的垃圾回收日志。

translation: 团队因她在大规模分布式系统设计方面的专长而聘用她。

translation: 在共享库代码中，优先使用显式类型标注而非隐式推断。

translation: 文档明确指出，写入后必须使缓存层失效。

translation: 该库在金融业的生产系统中被广泛使用。

translation: 特征提取器将原始日志行转换为结构化记录以供分析。

translation: 她开玩笑说不会有仙女教母来为我们重构遗留的支付模块。

example: The error logs look threatening, but the retry logic already handled the transient failure.
translation: 错误日志看起来很吓人，但重试逻辑已经处理了这次瞬时故障。

example: Good thrift in memory usage kept the embedded service running on tiny hardware.
translation: 在内存使用上的节俭，让这个嵌入式服务在极小的硬件上也能运行。

example: The scheduler wakes every tick to check whether any timer has expired.
translation: 调度器每一个节拍都会醒来，检查是否有定时器已经到期。

example: The dashboard's layout engine works like a tiler, snapping each widget onto a neat grid.
translation: 仪表盘的布局引擎就像贴砖工一样，把每个组件对齐到整齐的网格上。

example: The team named their build bot Toad after the intern compared legacy code to a swamp.
translation: 团队把构建机器人命名为 Toad，因为实习生曾把遗留代码比作沼泽。

example: We cannot tolerate a five-second page load; users will simply close the tab.
translation: 我们无法容忍五秒的页面加载，用户会直接关掉标签页。

example: Keep the tone of code review comments neutral; assume the author did their best.
translation: 代码评审评论的语气要保持中立，先相信作者已经尽了全力。

example: The new hire got a tour of the codebase from the senior engineer before lunch.
translation: 这名新员工在午饭前由资深工程师带着参观了一遍代码库。

example: Add a trace to every request so we can follow one payment across five services.
translation: 给每个请求加上 trace，这样我们就能追踪一笔支付穿过五个服务的过程。

example: Run traceroute to the database host to see which hop is adding the latency.
translation: 对数据库主机运行 traceroute，看看是哪一跳在增加延迟。

example: Distributed tracing shows exactly where the request spent its extra two hundred milliseconds.
translation: 分布式追踪能精确显示请求多出的两百毫秒花在了哪里。

example: The release is back on track after we fixed the failing integration test yesterday.
translation: 昨天修好了失败的集成测试之后，发布重新回到了正轨。

example: The high-frequency trader complained that one extra millisecond of latency cost real money.
translation: 这位高频交易员抱怨，多出一毫秒延迟就意味着真金白银的损失。

example: Rust traits let you define shared behavior that many different structs can implement.
translation: Rust 的 trait 让你定义共享行为，许多不同的结构体都可以实现它。

example: The project's trajectory changed after we replaced the monolith with three smaller services.
translation: 在用三个更小的服务替换单体之后，这个项目的发展轨迹改变了。

example: Every financial transaction must be atomic, so the service wraps it in a database transaction.
translation: 每笔金融交易都必须原子，所以服务会把它包进一个数据库事务里。

example: The CSS transition makes the panel slide smoothly instead of snapping into place.
translation: 这个 CSS 过渡让面板平滑滑入，而不是生硬地跳到位置上。

example: Transpose the rows and columns before feeding the matrix into the neural network.
translation: 在把矩阵喂给神经网络之前，先转置它的行和列。

example: A depth-first traversal visits every node before the recursion stack unwinds.
translation: 深度优先遍历会在递归栈展开前访问每一个节点。

example: Good documentation means treating beginners as future experts, not as nuisances.
translation: 好的文档意味着把初学者当作未来的专家，而不是麻烦。

example: The TV tuner card finally had drivers, so the media box could receive live channels.
translation: 这块电视调谐器卡终于有了驱动，媒体盒因此能接收直播频道。

example: Return a tuple of name and score instead of two separate lists from the query.
translation: 从查询中返回一个由姓名和分数组成的元组，而不是两个独立的列表。

example: The design team refined the typography of the docs site to improve readability on mobile devices.
translation: 设计团队优化了文档网站的排版，以提升移动设备上的可读性。

partOfSpeech: adjective (形容词); noun (名词); verb (动词)
example: We chose this framework because it is the ultimate tool for building data pipelines.
translation: 我们选择这个框架，因为它是构建数据管道的终极工具。

example: Requirements are still uncertain, so we should avoid committing to a fixed release date.
translation: 需求仍不确定，因此我们应避免承诺固定的发布日期。

example: The compiler throws an error when it encounters an undeclared variable in the function body.
translation: 编译器在函数体中遇到未声明的变量时，会抛出错误。

example: When joining a new team, expect to spend weeks reading unfamiliar code before writing features.
translation: 加入新团队时，预计要花数周阅读陌生的代码，之后才开始开发功能。

example: Type unification lets the compiler infer generics without explicit annotations in the method signature.
translation: 类型统一让编译器无需显式注解即可推断方法签名中的泛型。

example: The team migrated all services to a unified logging format to simplify debugging across clusters.
translation: 团队将所有服务迁移到统一的日志格式，以简化跨集群调试。

partOfSpeech: noun (名词); adjective (形容词); verb (动词)
example: REST requires a uniform interface so clients interact with every resource the same way.
translation: REST 要求统一的接口，使客户端以相同方式与每个资源交互。

example: We designed a universal adapter so legacy devices can talk to the new gateway.
translation: 我们设计了一个通用适配器，让旧设备能够与新网关通信。

example: The linter warns about unreachable code that can never execute after the early return.
translation: Linter 会对提前返回后永远无法执行的不可达代码发出警告。
extendedMeanings: 联系不上的，无法取得的

example: The benchmark result looked unreal, so we profiled the hot path to verify it.
translation: 这个基准测试结果好得看似不真实，于是我们剖析热点路径来验证。

example: The parser crashed because it hit an unrecognized token in the config file.
translation: 解析器崩溃了，因为它在配置文件中遇到了无法识别的词法单元。

example: The build failed with unsatisfied dependencies, so we pinned the missing library versions.
translation: 构建因存在未满足的依赖而失败，我们于是锁定了缺失的库版本。

example: The filter strips unwanted headers before forwarding requests to the internal microservice.
translation: 过滤器会在向内部微服务转发请求之前，剔除不需要的头部字段。

example: Rust lets you unwrap a Result, but you should handle errors explicitly in production code.
translation: Rust 允许你对 Result 解包，但在生产代码中应显式处理错误。

example: We sent the patch upstream so the open source project could merge it into main.
translation: 我们把补丁提交到上游，让这个开源项目能将其合入主干分支。

example: Our uptime target is 99.99%, so the on-call engineer monitors every deploy closely.
translation: 我们的正常运行时间目标是 99.99%，值班工程师会密切监视每次部署。

example: The function returns the cached value instead of recomputing it on every request.
translation: 该函数返回缓存的值，而不是对每个请求都重新计算。

example: The tutorial uses vanilla JavaScript so beginners can learn the DOM without extra frameworks.
translation: 该教程使用原生 JavaScript，初学者无需框架即可学习 DOM。

example: After days of debugging, the team finally vanquished the race condition in the payment service.
translation: 经过数日调试，团队终于消除了支付服务里的竞态条件。

example: He was vaping on the balcony during the conference break, talking about his startup.
translation: 会议休息时，他在阳台上吸电子烟，同时聊着自己的创业项目。

example: The release pipeline builds every variant of the app for different screen densities.
translation: 发布流水线会针对不同的屏幕密度，构建该应用的每一个变体。

example: Her varied background in graphics and databases made her a great systems engineer.
translation: 她在图形学与数据库方面多样的背景，使她成为出色的系统工程师。

example: The toolbox supports a wide variety of databases, from SQLite to distributed clusters.
translation: 该工具箱支持种类繁多的数据库，从 SQLite 到分布式集群。

example: We store all database credentials in Vault so developers never hardcode secrets.
translation: 我们把所有数据库凭证存储在 Vault 中，开发人员绝不硬编码密钥。

collocations.zh: HashiCorp Vault 密钥管理工具

example: Open source became a vehicle for collaboration between engineers across different companies.
translation: 开源成为不同公司的工程师之间开展协作的载体。

example: Before adopting a new database, we assessed vendor lock-in and exit costs.
translation: 在采用新数据库之前，我们评估了厂商锁定与退出成本。

example: Enable verbose logging during the incident so we can trace the failed requests.
translation: 故障期间请开启详细日志，以便我们追踪失败的请求。

example: The legacy system is on the verge of collapse, so we fast-tracked the migration plan.
translation: 旧系统濒临崩溃，因此我们加快了迁移计划的进度。

example: Uploading user data to third parties would violate the privacy policy and app store rules.
translation: 将用户数据上传给第三方，会违反隐私政策与应用商店规则。

example: The program crashed with an access violation after writing past the buffer boundary.
translation: 程序在写入越过缓冲区边界后崩溃，报出访问违例。

example: The hypervisor lets one physical server host dozens of virtual machines with isolated memory.
translation: 虚拟机监控程序让一台物理服务器托管数十台内存隔离的虚拟机。

example: The security team patched a critical vulnerability that allowed remote code execution.
translation: 安全团队修补了一个允许远程执行代码的严重漏洞。

example: The service takes a minute to warm up its cache before handling peak traffic.
translation: 该服务需要一分钟预热缓存，之后才能应对峰值流量。

example: The indie game features a winged protagonist who glides through procedurally generated ruins.
translation: 这款独立游戏的主角长着翅膀，在程序生成的废墟中滑翔。

example: We agreed on a wire format so services can exchange data across language boundaries.
translation: 我们约定了一种传输格式，让服务能跨语言边界交换数据。

example: The author decided to withdraw the pull request after review found a design flaw.
translation: 评审发现设计缺陷后，作者决定撤回这个拉取请求。

partOfSpeech: preposition (介词); adverb (副词); conjunction (连词); noun (名词)
example: The algorithm converges quickly without any manual tuning of its hyperparameters.
translation: 该算法无需任何手动调参即可快速收敛。

partOfSpeech: noun (名词); adjective (形容词); verb (动词)
example: The installer wizard guides new users through database configuration step by step.
translation: 安装向导会引导新用户一步步完成数据库配置。

example: Let's work out the cost of running this cluster before we present the budget.
translation: 我们先算出运行这个集群的成本，然后再呈交预算方案。

example: Postgres remains the workhorse of our stack, quietly serving millions of queries daily.
translation: Postgres 仍是我们技术栈的主力，每天默默处理数百万次查询。

example: The editor wraps long lines so the code stays readable on small screens.
translation: 编辑器会对过长的行自动换行，使代码在小屏幕上仍清晰可读。

example: A generator function uses yield to produce values lazily, saving memory on huge datasets.
translation: 生成器函数用 yield 惰性产出值，从而在处理大数据集时节省内存。

example: After the outage postmortem, the team joked that reviewing logs was cheaper than therapy.
translation: 故障复盘后，团队开玩笑说翻日志比看心理治疗还便宜。

example: The parser walks the AST with a zipper instead of rebuilding the whole tree.
translation: 解析器用 zipper 遍历 AST，而不是重建整棵树。

example: Our team tested a variety of databases before settling on PostgreSQL for the project.
translation: 团队在项目确定使用 PostgreSQL 之前测试了多种数据库。

example: Always store absolute paths in the config so the service runs from any directory.
translation: 在配置中始终保存绝对路径，这样服务可从任何目录运行。
